0022600111.text: The Phoenix Suns (0-1, 15th in the West) host the Golden State Warriors (0-1, 13th in the West) in the Suns' second game of the 2026-27 season, with both teams currently one game back in their divisions. This season's series has no games yet, and in 2025-26 the Suns lost the series 1-3, including a 101-97 loss in Phoenix on February 5, 2026. Mark Williams is out for Phoenix with a shoulder injury following surgery, while Luke Kennard (knee strain) and Oso Ighodaro (hip) are day-to-day with game-time decisions, and Golden State is missing Charles Bassey (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee, after surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee, after surgery).
